name: Table
description: Rows of structured data with aligned columns and optional sorting.

props.name: columns
props.type: { key: string; header: ReactNode; cell: (row) => ReactNode; align?: "start" | "end"; sortable?: boolean; className?: string }[]

props.name: caption
props.description: Names the table for assistive tech (visually hidden).

props.name: sort / onSortChange
props.description: Controlled sorting; sortable headers become buttons.

a11y: A real <table> with a caption, <th scope="col"> headers and aria-sort on the sorted column.
Sortable headers are buttons; numbers are right-aligned with tabular figures.
